source_instruction: i'm looking for a ultra hd digital camera with optical zoom lens.
query: I stopped by the community garden on my walk home yesterday, and the sun hit the tomato plants just right so all the little fuzzy hairs on the vines glowed like fine gold thread. One of the regular gardeners was passing out samples of the first ripe cherry tomatoes of the season, warm from the sun and so sweet they tasted like summer packed into a tiny, juicy bite, and I ended up chatting for 20 minutes about how they kept the squirrels off their beds this year by stringing old CD’s along the fence posts to glint and startle them away. I even spotted a tiny baby rabbit huddled under the sunflower patch, its ears still fuzzy and too big for its head, munching on a stray clover leaf like it didn’t have a single care in the whole world. I’ve heard that digital cameras with solid optical zoom work really well for capturing those little close-up, far-off moments that feel too special to fumble with a phone for. I’ve also heard there are little lens cleaning cloths that pair perfectly with those cameras, with the whole combination coming in under $20. I’ve heard those same camera options deliver that crisp, super sharp picture quality, you know the good stuff, nothing blurry or grainy even when you zoom in far.
